title: GitHub Custom Agent Frontmatter Schema
description: Repository contract for YAML frontmatter in .github/agents Markdown profiles. Description is the GitHub-required field; name is optional because GitHub can derive it from the filename.

name.description: Optional display name; the filename is used when omitted

description.description: Non-empty summary of the agent's expertise and when to use it

selectable.description: Repository compatibility alias checked against active registry entries
